summary: Plan re-validated (5 phases, 13 tasks). Phase merge preserved dependencies, disjoint ownership for parallel tasks and D1-D10 coverage. F7 and F8 are resolved: the spend table now totals 41.5 USD from now (about 46 of 60 including spend so far) with a shown reserve of about 14 USD, and the stop rule is based on stated USD figures that normal execution does not trigger.

criteria.description: Every D-criterion maps to a task with acceptance criteria and verification
Dependencies acyclic across merged phases, ownership disjoint among parallel tasks, docs ordered after live-eval
Cost realism and adequate reserve against remaining harness budget

findings.title: Shared log files between eval-harness and live-eval
findings.detail: eval/usage.log, holdout-runs.log and tuning-log.md are listed under both tasks, but live-eval depends on eval-tests which depends on eval-harness, so they are never concurrent.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Budget table exists, provider cap 8 USD, at most 3 tune runs, 1.5 USD per run, mirrored in live-eval criteria.
Planned total 41.5 plus 4.4 spent is about 46 of 60 with a reserve of about 14; stop at 36 USD before live runs and hard stop at 51 USD, both stated in USD and mirrored in live-eval criteria.
eval-harness criterion now notes the second holdout slot is reserved for a disclosed harness defect.
